doc.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Punctuality in the studios
summary: Studio dates are expensive so lateness is not tolerated.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: This incredibly long list of, not only people but movies and so forth, the music business requires you to really be on time and take care of business here. Is that correct?

Yeah. They want to start — well it’s very expensive. Everything in the entertainment business is so expensive now. I think for a minute it costs a hundred thousand dollars or something for a studio and a big orchestra; and the movies would be even more than that. So when you’re late it’s not good.
